parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake is located.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Set this to `true` to test the API call without making any changes. This checks if you have the required permissions and if the request parameters are valid. The default is `false`. When `DryRun` is `true`, the service returns a failure response with a reason, such as `DryRunOperationError` (the request would have succeeded), `ValidationError` (invalid parameters), or `AccessDeniedError` (insufficient permissions on the KMS resource).
